2116167755187798051.en_summary: @TheTeslaBull @DillonLoomis $TSLA bulls said the same thing about competitors catching TSLA on building out EVs, but that turned out to be false as Chinese EV manufacturers were able to quickly match TSLA on manufactured cost. I know: FSD is different…lol.
2116167755187798051.zh_summary: @TheTeslaBull @DillonLoomis $TSLA 多頭曾說競爭對手在建立電動車方面會趕上 TSLA，但結果是假的，因為中國電動車製造商能夠迅速匹配 TSLA 的製造成本。我知道：FSD 不一樣…lol。

2116167746631373091.en_summary: Pretty brutal seeing $INTC down over 30% when data center revenue just grew ~80% and Intel expects server CPU units to grow 30%+ in both 2026 and 2027. The irony is that Intel finally has demand it spent years waiting for but between its struggling PC business and costly manufacturing turnaround it still can't produce enough chips to fully capitalize on it.
2116167746631373091.zh_summary: 看到 $INTC 下跌超過 30% 相當殘酷，當時數據中心收入剛增長約 80%，英特爾預期伺服器 CPU 單位在 2026 和 2027 年都增長 30% 以上。諷刺的是英特爾終於有了等待多年的需求，但由於苦苦掙扎的 PC 業務和成本高昂的製造轉型，它仍無法生產足夠的晶片來充分利用。

2116167740260057121.en_summary: $APO Apollo Group CEO: "There have been enough incidents that we will eventually see some significant event around the world as a result of AI and typically significant events lead to regulation. I hope we get ahead of it and we do it in a really thoughtful way not in the heat of the moment but it will not surprise me to see us move to some form of regulatory oversight, protection of models, whatever it is the government decides to do. And I know that this is um something that's been pushed for around the world. It's quite frankly something that's been pushed for by the models themselves."
2116167740260057121.zh_summary: $APO Apollo Group CEO：「已經有足夠的事件，我們最終會看到因 AI 而在世界各地發生一些重大事件，而重大事件通常會導致監管。我希望我們能提前應對，以真正深思熟慮的方式進行，而不是在當下的熱度中，但看到我們轉向某種形式的監管監督、模型保護，無論政府決定做什麼，都不會讓我感到意外。我知道這是全球各地一直在推動的事情。坦白說，這是模型本身一直在推動的。」

2116166667692638704.en_summary: I think the Anthropic $ANT IPO really showed the danger of all the high AI stock valuations, and Anthropic's financials show the impossible task of profitable monetization, and Google reflected that in its earnings. But these market trends take a long time to change. In my opinion.
2116166667692638704.zh_summary: 我認為 Anthropic $ANT IPO 真正展示了所有高 AI 股票估值的危險，Anthropic 的財務狀況顯示盈利貨幣化的不可能任務，Google 在其收益中反映了這一點。但這些市場趨勢需要很長時間才能改變。依我之見。

2116166412024868892.zh_summary: 突發：英特爾 $INTC 當日跌幅擴大至 -30%，正朝著紀錄最大跌幅前進。即使是網際網路泡沫或 1970 年代也沒有看到 $INTC 如此跌幅。
